name: Spring Flower
source:
Main character is first year high school student, but he gets fascinated with third year high school student from athletics department. Persistence gets fruitful, no matter the same gender or two years difference. But they have not yet crossed the lover borderline. This spring protagonist prepares thoroughly for his friend's birthday to spend together at his apartment.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名高中一年級學生，卻被運動社團的一名高三學長吸引。只要堅持下去，性別相同或相差兩歲都不是問題。然而，兩人還沒有跨過戀人的界線。

這個春天，為了和朋友在自己的公寓裡一起度過生日，主角為此做了充分準備。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]］
